test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_min_max_from_statistics.parquet', Parquet) SELECT toInt64(sipHash64(number)) AS i, toUInt32(number) AS u, toDate('2020-01-01') + number % 3000 AS d, addMilliseconds(toDateTime64('2020-01-01 00:00:00', 3, 'UTC'), number) AS t, toDecimal64(number, 3) AS dec, if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, toInt64(number)) AS n FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT min(i), max(i) FROM file('test_parquet_min_max_from_statistics.parquet') FORMAT Null
SELECT min(d), max(d), min(t), max(t) FROM file('test_parquet_min_max_from_statistics.parquet') FORMAT Null
SELECT min(dec), max(dec), min(n), max(n) FROM file('test_parquet_min_max_from_statistics.parquet') FORMAT Null
